name: 혜진
visual_review: 보라색 긴 머리·날카로운 보랏빛 눈·한복풍 의상을 유지했습니다. 수인, 부적 올리기, 양팔 전개, 몸 회전, 밀어내기의 몸 동작이 다르고 다섯 부적이 궤도로 움직입니다.
motion_summary: Hyejin dark long purple-black hair, sharp violet eyes, traditional white-purple outfit and paper talisman from identity. Official R summons FIVE talismans orbiting her. Animate idle holding talisman; hands meet in ritual seal; lift talisman near shoulder; extend both arms; five small violet glowing paper talismans appear evenly around body; torso turns left as talismans orbit clockwise; sleeve and hair swing; right palm pushes orbit outward and talismans advance; five talismans briefly align in a ring below face, one compact purple pulse; hands pull back and talismans fade; sleeves settle; exact idle. No readable writing on charms, no giant monster faces, no extra sorceress. Actual hand seals and sleeve/torso movement, face kept unobscured.
